title: Total charge across a Lewis ion
statement:
A draft structure for a 2− ion assigns three atoms −1, 0 and +1. Is the formal-charge check satisfied?

[_]{a}

choices: No; the formal charges sum to zero.
Yes; having one negative atom is enough.
Yes; negative and positive charges should always cancel.
explanations: The electron placement or charge bookkeeping must be checked.
Cancellation would only work for a neutral species.
The sum is −2, not each individual charge.

hints: Their sum must equal the species charge.
solution: Add all the formal charges. Their sum must equal the species charge. Compare zero with −2. The electron placement or charge bookkeeping must be checked.
